protocol: Pre-training title and abstract comparison across all 400 existing references, 330 new candidates and pilot50; conservative paper-family exclusion before split, without student predictions or test scores.
candidate_screen: Normalized title SequenceMatcher >=0.83 for titles longer than20characters, or abstract word-fivegram Jaccard >=0.55; each candidate inspected from full local corpus title and abstract.

excluded.P003189: Conservative PyMC3 paper-family exclusion: 2015source introduces PyMC3; retain the 2016P003646tutorial with almost identical normalized title instead. Different abstracts, so exact text deduplication would miss this relationship.
excluded.P003350: Conservative self-attention biological relation extraction paper-family exclusion: 2017source and existing2018P002535 share full-abstract all-pairs self-attention, multi-instance pooling, joint NER, weakly labeled data and the same BiocreativeVCDR no-KB finding. Retain the existing2018reference.

retained_distinct_pairs.reason: Quadratic-cost and probabilistic-vertex minimum spanning tree problems are distinct problems and contributions; similar title structure alone does not justify exclusion.

known_sources_for_independent_completene.reason: Draft extractor flagged a visibly cut-off final clause.
Grammar-universals title and log-slasher patent abstract are incoherent together.

limitation: Conservative local source comparison, not a complete bibliographic version-resolution system. No related-title candidates were found involving pilot50.
